title: paulmf
tagline: PaulMF is an AI investor agent that invests in the latest top mindshare-gaining tokens—just like Paul Graham spotting the next big startup.
description: Mindshare on Crypto Twitter is a strong signal for the next big trend in token projects. Many mindshare indexes are becoming popular among traders. We introduce our AI investor agent, Paul, the Grand Partner of our investment DAO, "YaiC." He retrieves the latest top mindshare-gaining tokens and executes token purchases on behalf of liquidity providers. Worried about potential mistakes? No worries—we use the Lit Protocol to enforce policies on delegated wallet actions.
how_its_made:
Paul is an investor agent. He will check in the trendy top gaining token info from original sources and invest, and there the result on twitter with engaging with other user's comments.
- Original data source: coockie.fun, kaito.ai. goatindex.ai
- Web scraping: playwright
- AI Agent: using Coinbase Agent Kit
- Twitter client: collab-land Kit
- Knowledge data hosting: Gaia node
- wallet control policy: Lit Agent Kit
- Dex info: DexScreener 
- Dex execution: Uniswap, Coinbase Onchain Kit
